Chapter 02 · Mechanism of Action

Two pathways,
one molecule

Neprilysin inhibition meets RAAS blockade — the dual-acting basis of every benefit that follows.

Entresto® at Ten · 04 / 40
§ 02 · What is ARNI?

Sacubitril / Valsartan

A first-in-class dual-acting neurohormonal modulator.

Sacubitril — Neprilysin Inhibitor
  • Blocks degradation of natriuretic peptides (ANP, BNP, CNP)
  • Increases bradykinin levels
→ Natriuresis · Vasodilation · Anti-fibrosis
Valsartan — AT₁ Receptor Blocker
  • Blocks angiotensin II at the AT₁ receptor
  • Inhibits RAAS over-activation
→ ↓ Aldosterone · Anti-remodeling
Dual neurohormonal pathway → ↑ Natriuresis · ↓ Fibrosis · ↓ Afterload · ↓ Remodeling = Synergy & dual protection.
參考文獻 References
Vardeny O, Miller R, Solomon SD. Combined neprilysin & RAS inhibition for HF. JACC Heart Fail 2014;2(6):663-70 (PMID 25306450) · McMurray JJV. PARADIGM-HF. NEJM 2014;371:993-1004 (PMID 25176015).
Entresto® at Ten · 05 / 40
§ 02 · Foundation of Synergy

Why ARNI protects the kidney

ComponentTargetEffect
SacubitrilNeprilysin inhibition↑ NP (ANP, BNP) · ↑ Bradykinin → Natriuresis, vasodilation, anti-fibrosis
ValsartanAT₁ receptor blockadeInhibits RAAS → ↓ Aldosterone, anti-remodeling
CombinedDual neurohormonalNP enhancement + RAAS suppression → cardio-renal protection

Why this matters for the kidney

  • Natriuretic peptides are endogenous renal protectors.
  • Promote afferent arteriolar vasodilation → ↓ intraglomerular pressure.
  • Combined with efferent vasodilation → dual glomerular protection.
  • Anti-fibrotic effects reduce tubulo-interstitial fibrosis.
Two arterioles, one principle — NP relax the afferent, Valsartan relaxes the efferent; the glomerulus is decompressed from both sides.
參考文獻 References
Packer M. Circulation 2015;131(1):54-61 (PMID 25403646) · Damman K. PARADIGM-HF renal effects. JACC Heart Fail 2018;6(6):489-98 (PMID 29655829) · Judge P. Neprilysin inhibition in CKD. NDT 2015;30(5):738-43 (PMID 25140014).
Entresto® at Ten · 06 / 40
§ 02 · The Concept Born from a Failure

The drug that almost wasn’t

Omapatrilat — the late-1990s vasopeptidase inhibitor that blocked both ACE and neprilysin.

OVERTURE (2002)Chronic HF, n=5,770. Omapatrilat not superior to enalapril.
OCTAVE (2004)Hypertension, n=25,302. Angioedema 3.0× higher vs enalapril (2.17% vs 0.68%).
FDA decision2002 — Refused approval. Vasopeptidase inhibition abandoned.

The design lesson that gave us ARNI

  • Bradykinin is degraded by both ACE and NEP.
  • Block both → bradykinin accumulates → angioedema risk soars.
  • Solution: pair NEP inhibition with an ARB, not an ACEi — spare ACE so bradykinin still has a clearance pathway.
  • Novartis embodied this in LCZ696 — sacubitril co-crystallised 1:1 with valsartan.
One ACE-inhibitor decision — replaced by an ARB — turned a failed drug class into a Class I therapy.
參考文獻 References
Packer M. OVERTURE. Circulation 2002;106(8):920-6 (PMID 12186794) · Kostis JB. OCTAVE. Am J Hypertens 2004;17(2):103-11 (PMID 14751650) · Hubers SA, Brown NJ. Circulation 2016;133(11):1115-24 (PMID 26976916).

§ 02 · The Phase 2 Stepping Stone

PARAMOUNT — the trial that earned two Phase 3s

TrialPARAMOUNT (Solomon SD et al.)
YearLancet 2012;380:1387-95
Population301 patients · LVEF ≥ 45%
ComparatorLCZ696 vs valsartan, 36 weeks
PrimaryNT-proBNP change at week 12
ResultPre-specified primary met (p = 0.005)

Why PARAMOUNT mattered

  • First clinical confirmation that pairing NEP-i with an ARB was tolerable — no angioedema excess.
  • Provided the regulatory rationale to launch PARADIGM-HF (HFrEF) → positive 2014, and PARAGON-HF (LVEF ≥45%) → near-miss 2019.
  • Established NT-proBNP as a Phase 2 surrogate — still used today (PIONEER, PARAGLIDE, PREMIER).

§ 03 · The Field that PARADIGM Created

One trial in 2014 → 2,607 peer-reviewed papers by 2026

2,607

386

  • 2014 → 2022: a 12-fold increase in annual output, peaking with the AHA/ACC/HFSA Class I HFrEF guideline.
  • 2024-25: literature shifts from RCTs to real-world cohorts (Swedish nationwide, US Optum) and Asian-specific data (PREMIER, KorAHF, TSOC).

PubMed search 2026-05-10: ("sacubitril/valsartan" OR "LCZ696" OR "Entresto"). 2026 = Jan–May (annualised projection ~315).

§ 05 · Glomerular Hemodynamics

Two arterioles, one principle

Sacubitril · ↑ ANP/BNP
Afferent arteriolar vasodilation
Valsartan · ↓ Angiotensin II
Efferent arteriolar vasodilation
The result — ↓ intraglomerular pressure + ↓ renal fibrosis → long-term nephroprotection (decompression from both sides).

PARADIGM-HF renal data

  • ↓21% CV death and HFH in CKD patients (eGFR +0.43 mL/min/yr vs enalapril).

  • Benign UACR rise reflects mesangial relaxation, not podocyte damage.

CKD dosing considerations

  • eGFR 30–60 — standard initiation; monitor K⁺/Cr at 1–2 wks
  • eGFR <30 — low-dose 24/26 mg BID; slow titration 4–8 wks
  • Dialysis — 24/26 mg BID on non-dialysis days
  • ACEi washout — 36-hour washout mandatory
In dialysis, hyperkalemia risk falls — not rises.

§ 08 · Daily Practice

2024 ACC ECDP — ARNI is first-line

ARNI is the 1st-line Class I therapy for HFrEF. ACEi/ARB only if ARNI is contraindicated or not tolerated.

eGFRStarting doseTitrationMonitoring
≥3049/51 mg BIDq2 wks → 97/103 mg BIDStandard
<30 / Dialysis24/26 mg BIDSlow 2–4 wk titrationK⁺, BP, Cr each step

Titration algorithm

  1. Identify eligible HFrEF patient (LVEF ≤40%).
  2. Check eGFR, K⁺, SBP → eGFR ≥30, K⁺ <5.2, SBP ≥100 = standard pathway; eGFR <30 or dialysis = low-dose pathway.
  3. ACEi washout (36 hours) if applicable.
  4. Initiate Entresto — 49/51 mg BID standard · 24/26 mg BID low-dose.
  5. Monitor at 1–2 weeks — BP, K⁺, Cr.
  6. Up-titrate if tolerated → target 97/103 mg BID.
  7. Follow-up — renal function q3–6 months.

§ Closing

Five things to remember

01
A decade of proven excellence.
PARADIGM-HF established ARNI as the gold standard; subsequent trials and RWE have only strengthened the evidence.
02
New evidence confirms broad benefits.
Japan PREMIER, Swedish nationwide (SwedeHF) and US Optum RWE confirm benefit across populations.
03
Consistent benefit across the CKD spectrum.
From normal eGFR to ESKD on dialysis — cardio-renal protection at every stage.
04
De novo HFrEF — start early.
First-line ARNI in de novo HFrEF cuts all-cause hospitalization by 19% (primary); exploratory mortality signal suggests a 30% reduction (Bhatt 2025).
05
Act now — don't wait.
2024 ACC ECDP positions ARNI as 1st line. Early initiation maximizes reverse remodeling — delay is a choice with consequences.

§ Closing

Ten years. One molecule.
A decade of evidence.

From PARADIGM to the bedside

From a single landmark trial in 2014 to a decade of evidence spanning HFrEF, preserved-EF heart failure, acute decompensation, CKD stage 3b, and dialysis. From North America to Asia. From the failure of Omapatrilat to ARNI as Class I first-line therapy in 2024.

The next ten years

Generic competition will broaden access. The remaining work is to close the prescribing gap — especially in CKD 3b-and-beyond, where evidence is now solid but treatment rates remain only single-digit percent.

Mu-Yang Hsieh, MD, PhD, FESC · NTUH Hsin-Chu Branch · TSOC 2026
